slides.headline: A $45 BILLION AI FUND COLLAPSED IN DAYS
HE BUILT A $45 BILLION AI FUND IN TWO YEARS
slides.body: Leopold Aschenbrenner left OpenAI and bet everything on AI stocks. Launched July 2024. Two years later: $45 billion, returns over 1,000%

slides.headline: HE BORROWED $4 FOR EVERY $1 HE HAD
slides.body: For every $1 the fund had, it borrowed $4 more. That's 400% leverage. When stocks dropped, his losses hit 4x as fast

slides.headline: THE FUND CRASHED TO $10 BILLION BY THURSDAY
slides.body: Went from $45 billion to $10 billion by Thursday. Had to sell it all to Citadel at a steep discount. His wedding was that same week

slides.headline: HE WORKED FOR SAM BANKMAN-FRIED
slides.body: Before the fund, he helped Sam Bankman-Fried run a charity from a Bahamas penthouse. Graduated high school at 15, Columbia valedictorian at 19. People close to him called this collapse "not if, but when"

slides.headline: HE GAMBLED $45 BILLION ON THE WRONG PLAY
slides.body: Bet $45 billion on AI stocks. Lost most of it in days. The businesses making real money put AI to work, they don't bet on it

slides.headline: THIS WON'T BE THE LAST AI BLOWUP
slides.body: Follow so you see who bets it all next. Send this to the friend who thinks AI stocks only go up

caption:
Swipe to see how a former OpenAI researcher built a $45 billion fund and lost most of it before his wedding 💰

Leopold Aschenbrenner, a former OpenAI researcher, started an AI hedge fund in July 2024, ran it up to $45 billion with over 1,000% gains, used 400% leverage on stocks like SK Hynix and CoreWeave, watched it crash to $10 billion in days, sold everything to Citadel at a discount, all the week of his wedding. Before the fund, he worked for Sam Bankman-Fried at FTX.

AI is creating and destroying fortunes faster than anything before it. One bad week erased $35 billion. The people who win with AI won't be the ones gambling on stocks. They'll be the ones actually using it.
